{{Top|leg}}
'''Last Call''' was a 700 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] deep valley located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]]. It was littered with the bodies of unfortunate [[Korbinite]]s and offworlders that had been [[Death/Legends|killed]] on the planet. The establishment of Last Call was an effort to prevent the corpses spreading disease in the [[City/Legends|cities]].
